name: Egeralja (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egeralja (a red shield with a white ploughshare, a sabre and a hand, within a green wreath) above the name EGERALJA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
